criterion_source: Vendored contracts/ws1/acceptance.json WS-PERF06 is the only G-id sentence in the pinned WS1 r1 set: missing supporting hardware evidence blocks a G2/G5 claim. agent-handover.md and simulation-measurement-contract.md are named in the PR review and are not in the vendored pin set, so G0, G1, G3, and G4 have no criterion text in this tree.

placement.current: Host-native processes on the launcher host. The fill demo does not enter the S0 guest. CAH_MODE=outer runs S0 and exits without injecting these stubs.
placement.simulator_owner: test-suites/eggomi owns the outer simulated-SNP substrate. CAH does not start a second simulator.
placement.proposed_eggomi_neighbor: Coordinator-described infra/dstack layout. Not inspected. No Eggomi commit SHA was read.

mount.keeper: Unconfined. Owns state/authority, including the lab CA key, keeper policy, grant store, and journal.
mount.other_processes: User and mount namespace. Hides state/authority and state/roles, bind-mounts only that process's role directory, and remounts admission.json read-only.
mount.same_uid_ptrace: Not additionally blocked. This is an E1 limit.

egress.host_network: Unrestricted on this host-native slice. WS-NET01 is not claimed.
egress.af_vsock: Not opened. open_vsock raises VsockUnavailable. The label is a local byte forwarder.
egress.proposed: Egress allowlists stay on the Eggomi egress role. The stub broker does not implement them.

key_inventory.notes: One-day lab CA. Public certificate is copied to state/public/ca.crt. Unix transport does not create this key. SPIRE is not started.

key_inventory.readers: That instance's confined mount keeps only its own role directory. Other instance keys stay under the hidden authority directory.
key_inventory.notes: Unix transport does not issue TLS instance keys. Every transport has an X25519 channel key at state/roles/<instance>/channel.key. Browser guards store it wrapped at channel.key.wrapped. The fence secret is state/fence/<instance>, outside the guard role directory.

key_inventory.readers: Keeper only. Confined processes hide state/authority. The broker does not receive the plaintext.
key_inventory.notes: Lab canary cah-synthetic-fill-v1. Keeper seals it to the guard channel key under the keeper static key. The canary scan ignores this file. The only result files that may contain the opened value are results/positive_fill.json and results/copied_owner_fill.json.

key_inventory.readers: Keeper. Confined processes hide state/authority and state/host-fence.
key_inventory.notes: Consumption and boot revocation are appended to the host fence, outside authority/. Restoring authority/ does not revive a journaled grant. The guard fence at state/fence/<instance> is hidden from other compartments.

key_inventory.readers: Launcher and keeper write it under the lock. Confined processes see a read-only bind.
key_inventory.notes: The launcher writes a scoped row in-process. Keeper-core does not expose AdmitWorkload. A certificate-fingerprint change advances boot_generation and the caller revokes that instance's issued grants. The wire code is denied_boot.
